studentJourneyDraft.title: Welcome! 🦉
studentJourneyDraft.owlText: Hello, friend! Today we are going to learn about counting by tens. This is going to be a fun Math adventure! Are you ready to begin?

studentJourneyDraft.title: Today's Mission 🎯
studentJourneyDraft.studentText:
By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

✓ Count forward and backward by tens up to 100
studentJourneyDraft.owlText: This is your mission! By the end of this lesson, you will be skilled at counting by tens. Let us begin!

illustration.prompt: A colorful math mission banner for children showing the learning goal: count forward and backward by tens up to 100, bright engaging colors

studentJourneyDraft.title: Think First! 💭
studentJourneyDraft.studentText: Let's count by tens! 10, 20, 30, 40... Each time we add 10 more. Can you count to 100 by tens?
studentJourneyDraft.owlText: Take a moment to think about counting by tens. What do you already know? There's no wrong answer!

interaction.prompt: What do you already know about counting by tens?
interaction.hint: What number comes after 30 when counting by tens?
